# Wuttiphong Butta (วุฒิพงษ์ บุตตา)

> Thai software engineer. Computer Science, Bangkok University (2026). AI & Technology Specialist at Give Education and Aquatots Thailand. Former AI Engineer intern at Smarterware Co., Ltd.

## Work
- AI OCR: fine-tuned Typhoon OCR with LoRA (Unsloth) at Smarterware; 98.88% text-extraction accuracy on Thai and English invoices; FastAPI, Docker, AWS SageMaker.
- ORBIT Platform: one internal platform replacing four separate tools. Demo: https://youtu.be/Roqlzw3cLno
- STQ Orbit: corrects and validates accounting data before QuickBooks and issues receipts automatically.
- AI Chatbot (RAG): LINE OA chatbot that answers with sources.
- qwenmythos: 4B-parameter open-weights reasoning model, DoRA fine-tuning. https://huggingface.co/Wuttiphong23/qwenmythos_Version_1.0
- SEO, GEO and AEO audits for freelance clients.

## Sport
- TaeKwonDo: second runner-up, 33rd National Youth Games (Chumphon-Ranong Games); second runner-up, 35th Kanchanaburi Games; first runner-up, Chula Open; 4th, Thailand Championship (cadet).
- Represented Bangkok University at Thammasat University Games and Lopburi province in basketball.
- Assistant TaeKwonDo coach with teams from Singapore, China and Taiwan. Best athlete (MVP) awards at provincial and national events.
